description: Full floor-free ORB census: 1,920 configurations, 194,005 simulated trades, net of commission, exchange fee and slippage.
schema: symbol, source, tf, orlen(min), entry(break|retest), stop(opp|mid|atr), target(rw1|rw2|r1|r2|r3), sessions, breaks, filled, break_rate, fill_rate, trade_rate, n, win, avg_win, avg_loss, payoff, pf, exp(R), sd, t, sharpe, sortino, maxdd(R), avgdd(R), max_cons_w, max_cons_l, mae(R), mfe(R), dur_min, pct_stop, pct_tgt, pct_eod, is_*/oos_* (60/40 temporal split), sl_exp/sl_n (three disjoint periods)
rth_only: YES - deliberately enabled, each contract's own open (MGC 08:20, MCL 09:00, MES/MNQ/NQ 09:30 ET)

sources.deep: data/*_1m.csv Oanda CFD 1m 2019-01..2020-05, 346-352 RTH sessions, MGC/MES/MNQ only, NOT the futures price
sources.raw: csv/raw Yahoo futures, 18-19 RTH sessions per symbol, all five symbols
